description: MCP server for GroupDocs.Metadata — read, search, write, and remove document metadata.

lifecycle.reason: Missing required package metadata (runtimeHint not provided and registryType='nuget' not in the inference table)

name: io.github.groupdocs-metadata/groupdocs-metadata-mcp

storage_path.description: Base folder for input and output files. Defaults to the current working directory.

output_path.description: Optional — separate folder for output files. Defaults to GROUPDOCS_MCP_STORAGE_PATH.

license_path.description: Path to the GroupDocs.Total.lic license file. Omit to run in evaluation mode.

metered_public_key.description: Metered (pay-per-use) public key. Requires GROUPDOCS_METERED_PRIVATE_KEY as well. Takes precedence over GROUPDOCS_LICENSE_PATH. Metered mode reports usage to GroupDocs servers, so it needs outbound connectivity.

metered_private_key.description: Metered (pay-per-use) private key. Treat as a secret: supply it via an environment variable or a secret store, never hardcoded in a committed MCP client config.
